runs.name: the archive/return-then-explore core imports (goexplore.py + its non-MuJoCo chain)
runs.cmd: for m in basics import_ai explorers utils goexplore montezuma_env generic_atari_env; do python -c "import goexplore_py.$m" || exit 1; done; echo IMPORTS_OK

runs.name: the two MuJoCo-coupled modules are named blocked, not silently skipped
runs.cmd: python -c 'import goexplore_py.randselectors' 2>&1; echo rc=$?; python -c 'import goexplore_py.complex_fetch_env' 2>&1 | grep -i mujoco

tests.name: goexplore.py (archive, cells, return-then-explore) is importable and exposes its module surface
tests.cmd: python -c "import goexplore_py.goexplore as g; print('DONE' in dir(g), 'has_goexplore_module', bool(g.__file__))"
